about: Animated's native driver (sample/AnimatedProbe.tsx), React Native's C++ implementation as Android runs it: the probe and Bloom's Switch mount (without NativeAnimatedModule they throw at once, 'Native animated module is not available'); a press runs three 600 ms linear animations on the native driver, each frame's opacity, transform and colour set on the views between commits where a linear animation is at that frame's time, ending exactly at their values, drawn there, and JavaScript told of each end once; the moved box is pressed where the driver moved it; they run back; a scroll view's onScroll, through Animated.event on the native driver, moves a bar as far as the view scrolled; a 600 ms Animated.timing in JavaScript (useNativeDriver false) commits once a frame of requestAnimationFrame, which the host runs once a display frame as Android's Choreographer does (React Native's own runs it as a zero-delay timer: about 600 commits), each frame's value where a linear animation is at its time; and Bloom's Switch turns on with one press, its thumb moved along the track, and calls onCheckedChange once.

steps.name: a press on Start runs the three animations on the native driver: each frame's value is where a linear 600 ms animation is, from the start to exactly the end, and they are drawn at their end: the faded box opaque, the moved box 200 to the right and gone from its layout, the tinted box blue; JavaScript is told of each end
a press where the driver moved the box reaches it, and where its layout alone would put it reaches the page
the moved box's layout is the page's
a press on Back runs them back to where they started
the wheel scrolls the scroll view 40 down: its onScroll, through Animated.event on the native driver, moves the bar 40 to the right, set from the scroll event and drawn there

a press on JS runs a 600 ms linear Animated.timing in JavaScript: requestAnimationFrame runs once a display frame, never sooner, on performance.now()'s clock, and each of its frames commits the box where a linear animation is at that frame's time, about 36 in all, not one per turn of the loop; it ends 150 to the right

requestAnimationFrame and cancelAnimationFrame: of three callbacks, the one cancelled at once and the one the first cancels in the same frame do not run; one asked for during a frame runs in the next, later, and no frame's time is ahead of performance.now()

one press turns Bloom's Switch on: its thumb moves from the track's start to its end over the track's new colour, its spring a frame of requestAnimationFrame each display frame, and onCheckedChange is called once
